data.long_meaning: Muhannadah is a female Arabic name derived from the root 'h-n-d' which means 'to devote' or 'to dedicate'. This name signifies a deep commitment and devotion to God. The name Muhannadah carries the meaning “Devoted to God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhannadah usually hope their child will grow to embody devoted to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
